'''I Love Crying''' is the sixth episode of {{S|51}}.
==Story==
===Day 11===
===Day 12===
==Challenges==
'''Immunity Challenge:''' ''[[Challenge Pitch|UnBraidy]] [[Knot Your Fault|Bunch]]''<br />The castaways are going to race to untangle themselves from braided ropes. They'll then use those ropes to pull a sled of sandbags to them. Then one at a time, they'll use the sandbags to knock off every piece of their puzzle from that platform, and then they will work together to use all those pieces to build a large ''Survivor'' puzzle.<br />'''Winners (in order of finish):''' {{tribeicon|toka}} and {{tribeicon|dina}}

===Voting Confessionals===
''Jelly was shown writing Ori's name down.''
{{confessional|savu|(''playing Shot in the Dark'') Can't wait for this to say "Safe". Right here. This is the one. Wish me luck.|Ori Jean-Charles|Ori|S51 ori t.png}}
===Final Words===
{{Confessional|none|Played my Shot in the Dark, it said 'Not Safe', and that was all she wrote. Got eliminated tonight, heartbroken right now. And I was playing with the people that I really, genuinely care for and enjoyed being around. When you go through the fight together, and when you starve together, it bonds you. It's an experience that I wouldn't it trade for nothing, it's undescribable honestly.|Ori Jean-Charles|Ori|S51 ori bw.png}}

*'''(Untitled):''' Kristin Flickinger spins a calculated cover story about her night on Exile Island to hide her new idol. But one tribemate is already seeing right through it.<ref>https://parade.com/tv/survivor-51-episode-6-deleted-scene-kristin-exile-island-lie</ref>

===Behind the Scenes===
===Other===
* The title of the episode was said by [[Eric Macksoud]] about how he feels comfortable letting out his negative emotions.
* After six consecutive [[Tribal Council]] eliminations by women, [[Ori Jean-Charles|Ori]] is the first man to be voted out, though [[Rob Antonson|not the first]] to be eliminated.
** Ori is also the only man to be voted out before the [[merge]].
